description: Man Utd 1–1 Spurs, United's trip to Atlético, Manchester City's 114 charges, Sydney FC's derby night, tables from around the world, rugby, NBA, tennis and a Fortnitemares survival guide.

articles.dek: Bryan Mbeumo's left foot. A red card for Spurs. Fifteen minutes with an extra man. And still, somehow, Manchester United could not hold on.
articles.toc_dek: Man Utd 1–1 Spurs: Mbeumo's thunderbolt, Bentancur's red, Solanke's sting.
articles.byline: Match report · Old Trafford · Saturday 10 October

articles.dek: Atlético Madrid at home is one of the sternest examinations in European football. It is also exactly the sort of night that made Manchester United famous.
articles.toc_dek: Atlético v United preview: the threats, the history and what time to wake up.
articles.byline: Preview · Riyadh Air Metropolitano · Tuesday 13 October (Wednesday 6am in Sydney)

articles.dek: An independent commission has found Manchester City guilty of 114 of the 115 charges against them. Football is stunned. So what should happen next?
articles.toc_dek: The verdict on Manchester City, what football is saying, and the punishment we would choose.

articles.dek: Arsenal fight back, Chelsea run riot, Brighton keep flying, and on Sunday Liverpool meet City. A day when, for once, we don't mind who loses.
articles.toc_dek: Every Saturday result in short, plus the big one at Anfield.

articles.dek: Barcelona have won all eight league games. Real Madrid won too, but Vinícius Júnior's afternoon went badly wrong, and El Clásico is only two weeks away.
articles.toc_dek: Barcelona 3–0 Getafe, Real Madrid 1–0 Villarreal, and the Clásico countdown.

articles.dek: The A-League season starts on Friday with the biggest game in Sydney: Sydney FC against Western Sydney Wanderers. Here's everything you need to know, and how to be there.
articles.toc_dek: Sydney FC's new season, the Talay twist, and a matchday guide for Allianz Stadium.
